description:
A team workspace for running AI coding agents in parallel with isolated Git worktrees, live diff review, GitHub integration, and mobile access.

Lody is a team agent workspace: share coding agents with your team on phone and desktop. Shared sessions, live diffs, and one control plane keep your team and agents in sync.
Run agents in parallel with isolated Git worktrees and live diff review, use subscriptions you already have with Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Kimi, and any agent that speaks ACP, manage the same control plane in the terminal with CLI commands, and ship together in one workspace with shared sessions, usage by member, and PR, CI, and merge status in-session.
Version 0.95.0
✨ New Features
- Add a managed built-in Pi agent. Migrating an existing Pi provider asks for confirmation and preserves its settings and stored history; previous Pi sessions cannot be resumed after migration, so start a new chat.
- Return approved session-share results directly to MCP agents.
- Launch Devin from the local CLI.
- Close and recover workspace-shared sessions more reliably.
🐛 Fixes & Improvements
- Fix DeepSeek Harness startup with some Node versions by running it with Lody's bundled Node.
- Fix an occasional blank iOS screen after the app resumes from the background.
- Improve interruption, recovery, background prefetch, and streaming behavior to reduce lost drafts and whole-conversation failures.
- Improve share requests, provider settings, error recovery, and archive behavior.
- Fix tool-input JSON being misread as Markdown math.
🤝 Community Contributions
- Special thanks to @tommy0103 for #711, and @Astro-Han for acp-extension-pi #1.
